2609.18494.title: Size Matters: Foundation Model for Czech HTML documents
2609.18494.paper_summary: Creating universal, high-quality representations of web documents in high-traffic industrial environments requires models that are both performant and economic. Existing approaches, however, often depend on large models, overlook the structural information inherent in HTML, or are constrained by short context windows, limiting their ability to process real-world web pages. We present HTML-LM, a compact foundation model with 154 million parameters that addresses these limitations through HTML-aware training and a ModernBERT-based architecture. It was trained on 100 million web documents using multiple objectives, including masked language modeling, bag-of-words prediction, and contrastive distillation from large language models. Consequently, HTML-LM sets a new state-of-the-art for classification and regression applications in the Czech Internet domain, surpassing both larger encoders and small-sized LLMs. The model is deployed in production, processing thousands of web documents per second, and released to the community under the CC BY-NC 4.0. https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm.
2609.18494.paper_summary_zh: 創建在高流量工業環境中具有普遍性和高品質的網頁文件表示需要性能和經濟性兼具的模型。然而，現有的方法往往依賴於大型模型，忽視了HTML中固有的結構信息，或受到短上下文窗口的限制，限制了它們處理現實世界網頁的能力。我們提出了HTML-LM，這是一個擁有1.54億參數的緊湊基礎模型，通過HTML感知訓練和基於ModernBERT的架構來解決這些限制。它在1億個網頁文件上進行了訓練，使用了多個目標，包括掩碼語言建模、詞袋預測和從大型語言模型中進行對比蒸餾。因此，HTML-LM在捷克互聯網領域的分類和回歸應用中創造了新的最先進水平，超越了較大的編碼器和小型LLM。該模型已在生產中部署，每秒處理數千個網頁文件，並根據CC BY-NC 4.0釋放給社區。 https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm.
